---
title: "Preliminary PAH Profiles by Sediment Location"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-20"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Import sample code
# ---------------------------------------------------------

sample_code <- read_excel(
  "Aim 2.3 Sediment Sample Code.xlsx"
)

# Parse abbreviation
sample_code <- sample_code %>%
  separate_wider_delim(
    Abbreviation,
    delim = "-",
    names = c(
      "Location_Code",
      "Treatment_Code",
      "Replicate",
      "Timepoint",
      "Dissolved_Code"
    ),
    too_few = "align_start"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Sediment_Location = case_when(
      Location_Code == "M" ~ "Mains",
      Location_Code == "S" ~ "Mains Sterile",
      Location_Code == "P" ~ "Pescara",
      Location_Code == "R" ~ "Republic",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    Treatment = case_when(
      Treatment_Code == "F" ~ "Free",
      Treatment_Code == "N" ~ "None",
      Treatment_Code == "S" ~ "Abiotic Capsule",
      Treatment_Code == "E" ~ "Encapsulated",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    Timepoint = as.numeric(Timepoint),

    Sample_Type = case_when(
      Dissolved_Code == "D" ~ "Dissolved Capsule",
      TRUE ~ "Sediment Slurry"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    -Location_Code,
    -Treatment_Code,
    -Dissolved_Code
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Import PAH results
# ---------------------------------------------------------

pah_results <- read_excel(
  "Sediment Concentration report.xlsx",
  sheet = "Concentration report"
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Make join variables the same type
# ---------------------------------------------------------

sample_code <- sample_code %>%
  mutate(
    `PAH Extract No.` = as.character(`PAH Extract No.`)
  )

pah_results <- pah_results %>%
  mutate(
    Replicate = as.character(Replicate)
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Join PAH results with sample information
# ---------------------------------------------------------

pah_joined <- pah_results %>%
  left_join(
    sample_code,
    by = c("Replicate" = "PAH Extract No.")
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Rename variables
# ---------------------------------------------------------

pah_joined <- pah_joined %>%
  rename(
    pah_extract_no = Replicate,
    pah_sample_type = `Sample Type`,
    molecule_name = `Molecule Name`,
    concentration = `Calculated Concentration`,
    batch_figures_of_merit = `Batch Figures Of Merit`,
    total_area = `Total Area`,
    molecule_retention_time = `Molecule Retention Time`,
    sample = Sample,
    replicate = Replicate.y,
    timepoint = Timepoint,
    sediment_location = Sediment_Location,
    treatment = Treatment,
    sample_type = Sample_Type
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Remove d10/d12 standards and unmatched samples
# ---------------------------------------------------------

pah_filtered <- pah_joined %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(sample_type),
    !str_detect(
      molecule_name,
      regex("d10|d12", ignore_case = TRUE)
    )
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Set factor order
# ---------------------------------------------------------

pah_filtered <- pah_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(
      treatment,
      levels = c(
        "None",
        "Free",
        "Abiotic Capsule",
        "Encapsulated"
      )
    ),

    timepoint = factor(
      timepoint,
      levels = c(0, 21, 42)
    ),

    sediment_location = factor(
      sediment_location,
      levels = c(
        "Mains",
        "Mains Sterile",
        "Pescara",
        "Republic"
      )
    )
  )
```

# Mains

## Sediment Slurry

```{r mains-sediment, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
pah_filtered %>%
  filter(
    sediment_location == "Mains",
    sample_type == "Sediment Slurry"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = timepoint,
      y = concentration,
      color = treatment
    )
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.1,
      dodge.width = 0.75
    ),
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ molecule_name,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 4
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Time (days)",
    y = "PAH Concentration",
    color = "Treatment",
    title = "Mains — Sediment Slurry"
  )
```
